items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Kenny Andrews on organ, Ben Turner on drum, Larry Slezak on tenor and once again I got to say Yours Truly, Arnett Cobb.

ctx.x: Been now over three years, three years this past December.
And who is with you there?
Kenny Andrews on organ, Ben Turner on drum, Larry Slezak on tenor and once again I got to say Yours Truly, Arnett Cobb.
